scope: Five independent native bodies plus four exact local-identifier projections. Child helpers are controlled substitutes; no composed UI/gameplay claim. Private resolver/info entries use regparm(2); copy/set adapters use regparm(3). Native info jump table is retained read-only with all 56 targets checked inside its function. Callbacks summarize descriptor, type data and the first 16 record/extension slots plus current generated and legacy records per player using hashes; every allocated record/extension and all other declared output fixtures are compared byte for byte at return. Bounded allocated 150-slot storage, valid IIDs, finite generated quantities and safe action arguments are required. The initializer deliberately repairs the signed-range predecessor bug: 901 low-ID cases differ only in the two source-coordinate output fields, verified explicitly; all other cases agree three ways, and native/reconstruction agree in every case.
